title: Test report
description: Execution of the test plan's stand cases on a deployed build. Valid only if the stand runs the head under test.

sha.description: The commit CI built and the stand was deployed from.

ci.description: CI on sha. If it is not green, stop: no deploy, no stand cases.

failure.description: Failing job and the tail of its output, when not success.

build_version.description: What the stand reports about its running build, e.g. the health endpoint's version. Must contain the first 7 characters of sha. Empty if CI was not green.

results.description: One entry per test case with runs_on stand. Empty if CI was not green.

actual.description: What was observed: read from the DOM, the plan, or the stand's logs, metrics or traces.

measurement.description: Required for every case that traces to a quality requirement; the script compares value to the requirement's threshold.

environment.description: Where measured, with its size for the tables involved, e.g. 'QA stand, history 23k rows'.

evidence.description: Screenshot path, redacted plan summary, or the log or metric query used.

residue.description: Every record this round created on the stand.

blocked.description: Set only when the round could not run: no access, cannot seed, deploy infrastructure down. Stops the loop. CI failing on the code is not a blocker; it goes in ci.

results.evidence: .tmp/run/stand-1/TC-AC2-2.png; order-versions: backward index scan, 0.8 ms, 1.2M history rows

results.actual: 501 rows via history primary key, backward scan
